record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: DRIFLOON (1 star) and DRIFBLIM (2 stars), the queued units. Ability.TAILWIND only: the identically named EffectEnum.TAILWIND (a Flying synergy effect) is a different mechanic and is not described here.
record.summary: Team-wide speed buff: every entity on the board that is on the caster's team (the caster included, no range or distance test) receives addSpeed(buff, caster, 1, crit), with buff 5 at 1 star, 10 at 2, 15 at 3, 30 at 4+ (DRIFLOON 5, DRIFBLIM 10, raw). For each recipient the value is first adjusted by its own Big Eater Belt helper (x1.25 rounded down to an integer), then scaled by the caster's AP (x (1 + AP/100)) and by critPower if the cast crit, with no rounding, and added to its speed clamped to 0..300. A recipient with the MELMETAL passive receives half the (Belt-adjusted) value as ATTACK instead and its speed does not change. The buff is not timed; it lasts for the fight. Requires no target.

targeting.who: all entities on the board whose team equals the caster's, including the caster; untargettable or other states are not tested

effects.target: every ally on the board including the caster

declaredRaw.note: requested speed amount per ally, raw; DRIFLOON 5, DRIFBLIM 10

effects.scaling: per recipient, in this order inside addSpeed(value, caster, apBoost 1, crit): Big Eater Belt of the RECIPIENT (value x1.25 rounded down, e.g. 5 -> 6, 10 -> 12), Twist Band (no effect on a positive value), then x (1 + caster AP/100) and x caster critPower if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT; canCritByDefault is false); no Math.round, so fractional speed is possible; result added to speed and clamped to 0..MAX_SPEED (300)
effects.resolution: applied change per ally = the figure above, limited by the clamp at 300; allies with the MELMETAL passive get addAttack(value x 0.5, caster, 1, crit) instead (value already Belt-adjusted; addAttack was not read here). The AP and crit scaling use the CASTER's ap and critPower for every ally; the recipient's own AP does not matter

buffs.note: see effects; permanent false, lasts for the fight; stacks additively on repeated casts up to 300

starBehavior.note: amount indexed by the caster's stars (pokemon.stars - 1), fallback 30; 15 and 30 are not reached by these units. maxPP 100 and range 2 for both (range only affects when the unit can attack; the buff has no range).

record.positionalConditions: None: the loop scans the whole board.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No state in the ability. Each cast adds again to every ally's speed (additive, clamp 300). No modes. Name collision: EffectEnum.TAILWIND is the first Flying synergy effect, added to Flying-type entities by the simulation and read by FlyingProtectionEffect (flyingProtection = 1); that is separate from this ability, which is dispatched only through AbilityStrategies[Ability.TAILWIND].
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: +5 (DRIFLOON) / +10 (DRIFBLIM) speed per ally. Applied per ally = (requested [x1.25 rounded down if that ally holds Big Eater Belt]) x (1 + caster AP/100) [x critPower], unrounded, clamped so speed stays within 0..300; MELMETAL-passive allies convert half of the Belt-adjusted value into ATTACK and gain no speed. The caster's own ally list includes itself.

When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, canCast)
Crit chance resolution (only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was read)
unresolved: NAME_SHARED_WITH_EFFECT: Ability.TAILWIND (this record) and EffectEnum.TAILWIND (Flying synergy effect) were separated by the registry key and the effect application sites cited above; what the flying protection value does in combat was not read and is not part of this record.

Consulted: TailwindStrategy, AbilityStrategy.process, castAbility, PokemonEntity.addSpeed, applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff / applyTwistBandBuff, MAX_SPEED and the sibling AGILITY record by name only (not compared). The queue record lists no dependencies.
PokemonEntity.addAttack (the MELMETAL branch) was not read, so the attack gain for such allies is described only as 'half of the value passed through addAttack'
